Examples.Title: Audio Transcription
Examples.Description: This endpoint allows you to transcribe audio.
Examples.Code:
### Audio Transcription
POST {{host}}/audio/transcriptions
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Toxicity: false
Pii: 
Replace-Method: 
Entity-List: ["ADDRESS"]
Injection: false
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Accept: application/json

{"model":"{{AUDIO_MODEL}}","file":"jfk.wav"}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful response.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: General error response.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Failed auth response.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Documents Extract
Examples.Description: This endpoint allows you to parse text from documents using OCR.
Examples.Code:
### Documents Extract
POST {{host}}/documents/extract
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Toxicity: true
Pii: replace
Replace-Method: category
Entity-List: ["ADDRESS"]
Injection: true
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Accept: application/json

{"file":"sample.pdf","embedImages":false,"outputFormat":"markdown","chunkDocument":true,"chunkSize":1000,"enableOCR":true}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful response.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: General error response.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Failed auth response.
# Content-Type: application/json
